class.name: MaszynaTrackRenderingBackend
class.brief_description: The tracks drawn as the original draws them ([code]Track.cpp[/code]).
class.description: MaSzyna's backend of [TrackRenderingServer], registered as [code]"maszyna"[/code] and chosen by a [MaszynaTrackData] ([method TrackData.get_rendering_backend]). Rails are swept from a rail profile ([code]<game dir>/models/tory/railprofile_<name>.txt[/code], its lines after [code]// switch blade[/code] the blade's), a switch's blades turn with its offsets, a trackbed of the track's section turns into the unique neighbour's ([code]Track.cpp:2825-2982[/code]), and a road is its surface and shoulders or curbs ([code]Track.cpp:3008-3256[/code]). A .scn's track is drawn with its own textures; any other [TrackData] with those its features map to ([code]maszyna_track_looks.tres[/code], a [MaszynaTrackLooks]). Streamed roads are drawn by cells of 125 m, one mesh of a surface per material each, streamed by [SceneryStreamingServer] as [code]"roads"[/code]. The materials come from [ReloadedMaterialServer], drawing both faces. Draws no sleepers - the original does not.

method.name: mesh_curve_bake_interval
method.description: How far apart a track of [param curve] is sampled as it is drawn [m]: 2% of an arc's radius, 10% of a curve's chord, 10 m for a straight line, within 2-10 m.

method.name: road_cell_exists
method.description: Whether the road cell [param cell] holds a road still.

method.name: road_cell_get_instance
method.description: The [RenderingServer] instance of the road cell; none before it is first built.

method.name: road_cell_get_mesh
method.description: The cell's roads as one mesh, a surface per material, while the cell is built; null otherwise.

method.name: switch_blade_layout
method.description: Which rail of each curve of a switch is its blade, and how far each blade is moved: [code]primary_blade_mirrored[/code], [code]primary_other_mirrored[/code], [code]secondary_blade_mirrored[/code], [code]secondary_other_mirrored[/code], [code]primary_blade_offset[/code], [code]secondary_blade_offset[/code].

method.name: track_get_instances
method.description: The [RenderingServer] instances the track has made so far, by their [enum Slot].

method.name: track_get_look
method.description: What the track is drawn with: [code]material1[/code], [code]material2[/code], [code]material_trackbed[/code], [code]tex_length[/code], [code]tex_height[/code], [code]tex_width[/code], [code]tex_slope[/code] and [code]railprofile[/code], by [MaszynaTrackData]'s names.

method.name: track_get_meshes
method.description: The meshes the track draws now, by their [enum Slot].

method.name: track_get_road_cell
method.description: The road cell drawing the streamed road; none for any other track.

method.name: unique_endpoint_connection
method.description: The one track joined to the endpoint [param endpoint_index] ([enum TrackServer.EndpointIndex]) of [param track]; null when none or several are.
